name: modpack
description: The claude-mods modpack: statusline, smart-compact, delegate, lsp-plus, cells, eta and seek, installed together and built to work together, and route, off until you turn it on.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: auto: once a day, check GitHub for a new claude-modpack release and install it in the background; it loads the next time Claude Code starts. notify: only say a new release is out. off: never check (no network request).

hookGuard.title: Hook guard
hookGuard.description: Stop waiting for another plugin's permission or notification hook after 10 s, so a hook that hangs cannot freeze Claude Code. Turn off if a hook of yours waits for you on purpose, such as approving from your phone.
